status: design target; SIMULATED, not built. Product preview: fully designed and simulated. Specifications are design targets for evaluation units shipping in Q1 2027.

sources.note: per-unit download H-F_params.json, copied in am_sdk/data/H-F/

notes: Continuous rating is the typical unit; end-of-life continuous 47.02 N m. Published continuous clamp 62 N m. Peak: 2 s event from a warm start.

assumptions.basis: AM SDK simulator model value (am_sdk/backends/sim.py), not a published rating. The one-node model is normalised so that 105 C is the winding temperature at the published continuous rating; the drive's own sensor thresholds (datasheet Protection Limits, e.g. derating onset 130 C and trip 150 C on M and H) use a different, physical scale
published unpowered backdrive torque used as Coulomb friction
viscous damping not specified in the published data; 0
no published time constant for this unit; conservative family value (shortest published family value), as in the SDK simulator
lumped heat capacity = 600 J/(kg K) x actuator mass (aluminium/steel/copper/magnet mix); an order-of-magnitude assumption; scales watts only
